prices.help: A model’s price comes from the first of: the price you set (You set), what the provider’s own API reports when its models are listed (From <provider>), or Coffer’s price list (Bundled) — shipped with each release and refreshed from genai-prices once a day unless that is turned off in Settings › General. A model with no known price shows “—”; set one so Usage can show its cost.

prices.perMillion: USD per 1M tokens. A cache rate left empty is charged at the input rate.

conflict.body: You edited it here since the pinned {{pinned}}, and the update {{to}} changes it too.
conflict.keepHelp: Stays pinned at {{pinned}} with your change. Coffer tells you again when there is a newer update.
conflict.takeHelp: Moves to {{to}}. Your edits are replaced.
conflict.confirmBody: Taking {{to}} replaces your edits to {{name}} with the update.
conflict.mergeHelp: Your agent merges the update into your edits. Then you record it with I merged it.

conflict.mergedBody: Coffer pins {{name}} to {{to}} and keeps its master folder's files as they are now. Check your agent's diff first.
